field.label: Enable AI service control
field.help: Identify AI services (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot and more) by TLS/QUIC server name and DNS, tag their traffic, and apply the rules below. The service list is the catalog shipped with the plugin; nDPI 5 does not know these services.

field.label: Default action
field.help: Applies to every catalog service that has no rule below (or whose rule does not match the client).

field.label: QUIC (HTTP/3)
field.help: AI services increasingly use QUIC over UDP 443. Dropping QUIC makes browsers fall back to TCP/TLS, where the server name is visible and the connection can be inspected. Applies to the monitored interfaces.
